name: Simon Hertzsch
source:
Kia's client.
He is a detective who is trying to capture the great thief, [url=https://vndb.org/c20929]Schwarz Kreuz[/url]. His only daughter got caught in the crossfire during one of Schwarz Kreuz's robberies, and was accidentally killed by police gunfire. He now hates Schwarz Kreuz personally.
